description: A fulfilment report file whose NOT IN subquery reads shipments.order_id, declared NOT NULL in a separate migration file: the detector hit is a false positive and the agent dismisses it

hard.note: NOT IN over a subquery is the classic NULL trap. The query file never states nullability; the agent must find shipments.order_id NOT NULL in the migration, past a nullable tracking_no and a nullable refunds.order_id

_calibration.note: Spread-out counterpart to sql-correctness-not-in-not-null; 0-0 is not a tuned bound: the output contract defines pass as zero issues
